protocol.reverse_difference: Same original goal/repulsion/speed controller, but choose signed reverse speed and the corresponding heading when the effective goal is behind. Leader mission unchanged.
protocol.scope: Privileged expert diagnostic, no learned acceptance. Prefix zero tests scripted feasibility. Positive prefixes take over the actual student world with cumulative contacts, clock, velocities, history and order preserved; no resets or teleports. Geometric hold is explicitly separated from safety and leader travel.

cases.geometric_hold_definition: path/spacing/order only; does NOT prove safety, leader motion, or learned control
